versions.changelog:
Big update: Adds full dividend tracking features throughout CLI and web UI.

- Dividend tracking support: yields, Yield on Cost, projected income, and ex-dividend dates.
- New commands: `dividends`, `dividend-summary`, and `calendar` for dividend-focused insights.
- Holdings listing now shows dividend info by default, with an option to skip.
- Enhanced README and SKILL.md to document all dividend features and usage.
- Web interface updated with dividend summary, breakdowns, and calendar views.

- Migrated CLI from JavaScript (portfolio.js) to TypeScript (portfolio.ts)
- Added support for selling holdings and tracking transactions (FIFO cost basis)
- Introduced transaction history and realized/unrealized P&L reporting
- Updated documentation and examples to use TypeScript
- Adjusted required files and data storage references in metadata and docs

Initial release of claw-portfolio.

- Track stock and crypto holdings locally via CLI.
- Get real-time prices and P&L for portfolio holdings.
- Manage multiple portfolios and switch between them.
- Export portfolio data to CSV.
- Optional web UI for portfolio management.
- Local data storage in JSON file.
